image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a dark-shelled turtle (likely a mud or musk turtle) walking on a substrate of multicolored aquarium gravel. The turtle's head is extended to the left, showing a pointed snout and lateral eye. The carapace is high-domed, dark brown/black, and appears slightly glossy with visible scute seams. One front limb is clearly visible, appearing stout with webbing and claws. The plastron is partially visible along the lower edge, appearing yellowish/cream. The background is a blurred greenish tank wall.
